title: Claude Code burns ~15–20% of your tokens on a 3-word status line
script:
Claude Code is burning fifteen to twenty percent of your tokens on a simple three-word status line.
Software developer Flamerix identified this issue while analyzing the agent's internal communication logs.
The agent repeatedly sends status updates like thought process active to the model with every prompt.
These redundant tokens accumulate quickly during long coding sessions in the terminal.
The analysis shows these status lines occupy a significant portion of the total context window.
You are effectively paying for repetitive filler instead of actual code logic.
Would you continue using these agents if they drain your budget this fast?
